import copy,json
from work import evaluate
cases=[
 ({'declared':['b','a','b','gone'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x','meta':{'n':1}},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':{'meta':{'n':1},'hash':'x','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'noise':{'v':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['b']}),
 ({'declared':['skip','x'],'saved':{'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}},'current':{'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'9'},'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':['skip']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
 ({'declared':['new','gone'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'}},'current':{'new':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['gone','new']}),
 ({'declared':['absent'],'saved':{},'current':{'absent':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
]
for i,(r,p,want) in enumerate(cases):
 rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(r),copy.deepcopy(p)
 got=evaluate(r,p)
 assert got==want,(i,got,want)
 assert r==rb and p==pb,(i,'mutated')
print(json.dumps({'passed':len(cases)}))
